1034. Banking Token System

60

Medium

Problem Statement:
Choose an appropriate data structures and create a token system for banking service (withdrawal, deposit and money transfer).
input_spec:
The first line of the input is the integer N denoting the number of bank accounts.

It is followed by the N lines of bank account details in the below format:

< account number > < name > < balance >

The last line of the input contains the operation that needs to be performed and the corresponding details depending upon the choice selected as follows:

1. Withdrawal :

The last line of the input will be in the format as below:

< choice > < account number > < withdrawal amount >

2. Deposit:

The last line of the input will be in the format as below:

< choice > < account number > < deposit amount >

3. Money Transfer:

The last line of the input will be in the format as below:

< choice > < from account number > < to account number > < transfer amount >
output_spec: Print all the back accounts after performing the selected banking operation
